scope: 0.12 candidate rendered performance, frozen 2ba4579 runtime; not final public PCK or multi-client network FPS

fixture.input: 8 normal owner-validated commands, 452 army units in one authority tick
fixture.response: 40 representatives, >=0.15m displacement; reversal additionally requires progress toward new slot and opposing old heading

measurement_limits: Pre-existing editor and normal user game preserved. First 14 runs and reverse-a1 retain the user game; it naturally exits between reverse-a1 and reverse-b1. Last three runs retain editor only. Within-run identities are stable. Final reversal ABBA FPS is not an uncontaminated temporal comparison.

Scene callback markers do not enclose native physics/navigation and are not total authority-step timings. Frame setup/render CPU/GPU counters are different domains and must not simply be added to callbacks.
Godot cached TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS/TIME_NAVIGATION_PROCESS window maxima are not per-tick P95; omitted from published timing tables.
Godot Forward+ MultiMesh LOD primitive counter omits instance multiplication; no primitive-count speedup claim.
Fixed seed and commands do not make Jolt/RVO a deterministic lockstep. Visibility, crowds, paths and combat evolution differ; single-factor samples are directional, not confidence intervals.
HP x100 keeps the 500-unit load stable; these are sustained-load scenarios, not normal-balance full matches. Snapshot encoding/Relay/8 separate client CPUs are not in these FPS measurements.
No new 896-unit rendered measurement. Neither 60 FPS at 500 nor a solved 896-unit extreme case is claimed.
Reverse response quantiles exclude censored representatives; pending counts are reported alongside them. Long detours are not expected to finish in 20 seconds.

recommendations.evidence: ABBA ~9.8% combined gain; batch-only 38.91 FPS; lower frame setup and render CPU; batch updater itself ~3.3ms/frame remains a hotspot.
Prior correctness supports safe stationary pruning. Current prune-only 34.74 FPS is inside original variance; independent FPS benefit is not established.

Combat positive directional samples, but repeated dense reversal leaves 4/5 pending vs native 3/3. Responded-only P95 is not worse, yet a behavioral regression cannot be excluded. Keep experimental, not default.

recommendations.candidate: omit unused path metadata and cache map iterations
recommendations.evidence: Removes hundreds of thousands of repeated native map iteration reads with per-tick cache, preserves native paths in prior oracle; standalone FPS gain not isolated.
Real shared samples and valid fields confirmed, but aggregate FPS and cold detour response not improved. Native requests still occur; routes/visibility change.
Prior all-skin experiments did not establish overall benefit; not retested or enabled here.
